subject: Geopolitics
title: China's Green Energy Dominance
description: Learn China's Green Energy Dominance in one minute.

hook.text: China makes 80% of solar panels, 60% of wind turbines, and 75% of lithium-ion batteries.

buildup.text: State subsidies, cheap labor, and industrial scale gave China a decade head start.

discovery.text: Controlling the supply chain for clean energy is as powerful as controlling oil wells.

twist.text: The US and EU are spending billions to build domestic green manufacturing. But reshoring takes years, not months.

climax.text: China bet early on green energy and won the manufacturing race.

punchline.text: Win the factory and you win the transition.

quiz.question: How does China dominate the green energy transition?
options: It has the most solar and wind resources
It manufactures most of the world's green energy equipment
It refuses to export any clean technology
